name: Terminbuchung & Kontakt-Button – Delta Booking Button
author: Delta Web Solution

sections.description:
Delta Booking Button macht aus deiner WordPress-Seite ein self-hosted Online-Terminbuchungs-System mit einem schwebenden Buchungs- und Kontakt-Button. Gebaut für lokale Dienstleister – Friseure, Coaches, Praxen, Kanzleien und Agenturen –, die Termine online annehmen wollen, ohne die Daten ihrer Kunden an einen externen Anbieter zu geben. Buchung, Erinnerungen und Kalender laufen komplett auf deinem Server: kein externer Buchungsdienst, kein CDN, kein IP-Leak.

Appointment Booking

  • Event Types — unlimited appointment types with custom duration, buffer time, working hours, and custom questions
  • Booking Popup — clean calendar with date and time-slot selection, opened from the floating button
  • Auto-Reminders — confirmation and 24h reminder email with an ICS calendar file attached, sent via WP-Cron
  • Self-Service Reschedule — token-based link, no login required for your client
  • External Calendar Sync (optional) — read busy times from an iCal/Google/Outlook feed to block double-bookings
  • Timezone Support — UTC storage, visitor-local display, DST-safe

Floating Button & CTA

  • Three Button Types — Single Button, Multi-Action FAB, Chat Widget
  • 369 Icons — Social, UI, E-Commerce, Brands, Arrows, Navigation (local SVG sprite, no CDN)
  • Smart Triggers — Time-based, Scroll Depth, Exit-Intent, Device, User State, URL Conditions
  • Action Types — booking, WhatsApp, Telegram, phone, SMS, email, links and webhooks

Conversion Tracking

  • Behavioral Tracking — Impressions, Clicks, Hover-Intent, Rage-Click Detection, Conversion Events
  • Funnel Analytics — Impression > Hover > Click > Conversion with drop-off rates
  • UTM Tracking — source/medium/campaign/content/term per click

Privacy & Self-Hosting (GDPR)

  • Everything runs on your own WordPress install — no third-party booking provider
  • All assets (CSS, JS, 369 SVG icons) are bundled locally — no CDN, no external requests
  • IP anonymization on by default; right-to-deletion endpoint included
  • Cookie-consent auto-detect: Borlabs Cookie, Cookiebot, Real Cookie Banner, Complianz — tracking starts only AFTER explicit consent
  • Email runs through your own wp_mail() configuration — no external email API

Performance

  • Conditional Loading — assets only on pages with active buttons
  • GPU-accelerated animations
  • Slim frontend: ~18 KB JS + ~8 KB CSS (gzipped), zero external requests
  • Custom DB tables (no wp_options spam)

Security

  • Nonce validation on all admin endpoints
  • Rate limiting (60 events/min/session)
  • Honeypot + time-check anti-spam
  • IP anonymization by default

More from us

Need forms too? Try our free Ultimate Form plugin — a drag-and-drop form builder with conditional logic, multi-step forms, spam protection and GDPR-friendly entry management. Learn more: https://delta-web-solution.de/ultimate-form

External Services

This plugin does not contact any external server for updates, telemetry, license verification, or analytics, and bundles all assets (CSS, JS, SVG icons) locally (no CDN). It connects to an external service only in the one optional, admin-controlled case described below.

External calendar (iCal) sync — optional, off by default

If — and only if — you enter an external calendar feed URL (an iCal/ICS link such as a Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, or Apple iCloud secret iCal address) for an appointment type, the plugin fetches that URL from your server to read busy times, so slots already taken in that calendar are blocked against double-booking.

  • What is sent and when: a standard HTTP GET request to the exact URL you configured, performed while the booking calendar computes available slots (the result is cached for about 15 minutes). No data about your site, visitors, or bookings is transmitted — the plugin only reads the calendar. If no iCal URL is configured, no request is ever made.
  • Where: the request goes only to the calendar provider whose URL you entered. Please review that provider’s terms and privacy policy, for example Google Calendar (https://policies.google.com/terms, https://policies.google.com/privacy), Microsoft (https://www.microsoft.com/servicesagreement, https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement) or Apple iCloud (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/icloud/, https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/).

Email and messenger links (no third-party servers)

  • Email (booking confirmations and reminders) is sent with WordPress’s built-in wp_mail() and your own server configuration. No external email API is used. ICS calendar files are generated locally and attached.
  • WhatsApp, Telegram and other messenger buttons generate standard https://wa.me/ and https://t.me/ links that open in the visitor’s own browser. The plugin sends no data to those services server-side.
  • If you configure a webhook action (admin-only), the destination URL is entirely under your control; no default webhook endpoint is pre-configured.

Privacy

Delta Booking Button captures anonymized interaction data for button performance analysis. No personal data is stored without explicit user consent. IP addresses are anonymized by default (last octet removed). Cookie consent is automatically respected through common consent plugins. A full privacy policy suggestion is registered in the WordPress privacy tool.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Walk through the onboarding wizard (5 steps, ~2 minutes)
  4. Create your first button or choose a template
  5. Test on the frontend
sections.faq:
Is the free version permanently free?

Yes. The free version remains free forever — unlimited buttons and appointment types, full analytics, and all triggers. No artificial limits.

What data is tracked?

By default: Impressions, Hovers, Clicks, Device type, anonymized IP, UTM parameters. NO personal data without explicit cookie consent.

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes. IP anonymization is active by default. Cookie consent integration with all major consent plugins. Right-to-deletion endpoint available. Data stays on your own WordPress installation.

Does it work with Elementor / Gutenberg / Divi?

Yes. Floating buttons are rendered globally and work with any page builder.

What happens on plugin uninstall?

When you delete the plugin, all tables, options, and user meta are cleanly removed.
sections.changelog:
2.1.1

  • Fixed: chat widget panels (mini chat, contact form, iframe) did not respond to mouse or touch input — fields and buttons inside the panel were unclickable. All widget variants are now fully interactive.
  • Fixed: contact form fields inside the chat widget could overflow the panel edge on some themes (missing box-sizing).
  • Fixed: the “sales button” wizard template referenced a non-existent icon, rendering an empty icon circle.
  • Fixed: the email action on a single button produced a double “mailto:mailto:” link, so the mail client opened with an invalid address. Email buttons now open correctly.
  • Fixed: the analytics “Export” link returned a 404 on sites using plain permalinks (default WordPress setting).
  • Fixed: in the button builder, selecting a sub-button kept the previous tab highlighted while showing the action panel — tab highlight and panel content now stay in sync.
  • Fixed: the bookings screen showed the number of buttons instead of bookings in its tab badge, and triggered PHP notices when WP_DEBUG was enabled.
  • Fixed: the customer “reschedule appointment” page showed every date as unavailable on sites with plain permalinks — self-service rescheduling now works.
  • Fixed: choosing “Book appointment” in the wizard silently saved a broken “open URL” action — the button did nothing when clicked. The wizard now saves the correct booking action.
  • Fixed: the internal button name typed in the wizard was discarded on save.
  • Fixed: on mobile, all floating buttons collapsed onto the exact same corner, covering each other (and footer links). Buttons now stack with proper spacing like on desktop.
  • Answers to custom booking questions are now visible in the bookings list (they were stored but never shown).
  • The wizard no longer suggests a Calendly URL for the built-in booking calendar.
  • Fixed: already-booked time slots could still be offered in the slot list (booking them was then rejected with an error). Availability filtering now reliably removes conflicting slots.
  • Admin design refresh — softer multi-layer shadows, larger corner radii, and harmonized form-control rounding for a more modern look (admin UI only; no frontend layout or structural changes).
  • Updated plugin screenshots to reflect the refreshed admin interface.

2.1.0

  • Frontend popups pixel-perfect implementation — Booking popup and WhatsApp mini-chat match design specs
  • Booking popup: Navy gradient header, two-line subtitle, improved calendar cells with navy border selection state
  • WhatsApp mini-chat: Green gradient header, proper avatar styling, WhatsApp-style bubble with timestamp
  • Master FAB icon color fix — no more yellow override
  • Click-only verification — popups only open on FAB click, never automatically
  • WP-Admin full-screen mode for plugin pages
  • Check button logic — blue checkmark triggers same submit path as green send button

2.0.0

  • Goal-first wizard — create a button in 30 seconds
  • Event types — custom appointment types with duration, buffer, working hours, custom questions, email templates
  • Step-0 event type picker for multiple appointment types
  • Timezone support — UTC storage, user-local display, DST-safe
  • Buffer time — pause before/after each appointment
  • Custom questions per event type
  • Auto-reminder — 24h reminder email with ICS attachment via WP-Cron
  • Self-service reschedule — token-based link, no login required
  • ICS generator (RFC 5545) — Apple Mail, Outlook, Gmail compatible
  • Theme color auto-detect
  • Migration v1.4 to v2.0 — existing slot config automatically converted
  • REST API v2

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • 3 button types: Single, Multi-FAB, Chat Widget
  • 369 Icons (SVG sprite)
  • Behavioral tracking: Impressions, Clicks, Hover, Rage-Click
  • 5-stage funnel
  • Smart triggers: Time, Scroll, Exit-Intent, Device
  • Cookie consent integration (Borlabs, Cookiebot, Real Cookie Banner, Complianz)
  • IP anonymization by default
  • GDPR right-to-deletion endpoint
  • Multisite compatible
  • Translation ready
